from statistics import mean

    {"year": "2003", "sales_growth_rate": None, "sales": None, "cost_of_goods_sold": None},
    {"year": "2004", "sales_growth_rate": None, "sales": 62.4976, "cost_of_goods_sold": 39.1213},
    {"year": "2005", "sales_growth_rate": 0.2428173, "sales": 77.6731, "cost_of_goods_sold": 50.5783},
    {"year": "2006", "sales_growth_rate": 0.1976193, "sales": 93.0228, "cost_of_goods_sold": 60.1861},
]

# Calculate the historical sales growth rates for the available years
sales_growth_rates = [
    0.2428173,  # 2005
    0.1976193   # 2006
]
average_sales_growth_rate = mean(sales_growth_rates)

# Calculate 2007 sales using the average sales growth rate
latest_sales = data[3]['sales']
sales_2007 = latest_sales * (1 + average_sales_growth_rate)

# Calculate the cost of goods sold as a percent of 2007 sales
cost_of_goods_sold_percentages = [
    data[2]['cost_of_goods_sold'] / data[2]['sales'],  # 2005
    data[3]['cost_of_goods_sold'] / data[3]['sales']   # 2006
]
average_cost_of_goods_sold_percentage = mean(cost_of_goods_sold_percentages)

cost_of_goods_sold_2007 = sales_2007 * average_cost_of_goods_sold_percentage

# Prepare the final answer
forecast = {
    "sales_growth_rate": average_sales_growth_rate,
    "sales": sales_2007,
    "cost_of_goods_sold": cost_of_goods_sold_2007,
}

final_answer(forecast)
